topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: This news about the building turning into condos don’t sit right with me. Folk coming in, buying up what we’ve called home, just so they can lock it tight and leave it empty half the time. Me and my neighbors, we worked the dark hours, kept the noise down, tended the gardens. Now they say we gotta pay more or move on. And where are we to go? With rents rising like the floodwaters, there’s little left for those who can’t plead for gold. The walls that stood to shelter us might as well be made of straw for all the good they’ll do us now.
